name: What are the benefits of building a Junior ADU on my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building a Junior ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a Junior ADU offers several benefits for homeowners. It can provide an additional source of rental income, help accommodate aging parents or adult children, or create a dedicated workspace. JADUs are often less expensive and complex to build than a full-sized ADU because they utilize existing structures and do not require new utility connections separate from the main house. They also contribute to increased housing density without significantly altering the neighborhood's character.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include rental income, housing for family, or a dedicated workspace. They are often more cost-effective and simpler to build than a full ADU.
